instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components as configured in the React repository.
Implement full mobile-first responsiveness with a fixed bottom navigation bar on mobile screen sizes.
All text content, product names, categories, and checkout forms must be in Turkish (TL ₺ currency).
Include both Supabase backend integration logic and local state / localStorage fallback so all CRUD operations (Add/Edit/Delete products, Order placement, Order status update) work seamlessly.
Ensure every clickable button, input, navigation item, modal trigger, and table row has exact data-testid attributes.
Use sonner for instant toast notifications when adding items to cart or updating orders.
